body.heading: Where in the world is Seychelles?
paragraphs: Seychelles is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Seychelles is Victoria.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Seychelles speak Seychellois Creole, English and French. Seychellois Creole, a French-based language born in the islands, is the one most people speak at home.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Seychelles is the Seychellois rupee.

body.heading: How big is Seychelles?
paragraphs: Seychelles covers about 452 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the smallest country in Africa. That makes it about half the size of São Tomé and Príncipe.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Often called the most photographed beach in the world, Anse Source d'Argent has giant granite boulders, powder-white sand and shallow turquoise water made for paddling.
In this ancient palm forest grows the coco de mer, the world's largest seed. Shady paths wind under palms that feel older than time.
